plugin.name: posterchan-shell
plugin._long: Disable interactive movement and resize only for registered desktop surfaces, and optionally keep the mouse pointer on the monitor a fullscreen window is using.

option.name: confine_pointer_to_fullscreen
option._short: Keep the pointer on a fullscreen window's monitor
option._long: While a fullscreen window is focused, the pointer cannot leave the monitor it is on. ON by default: a cursor sliding off a fullscreen game onto a second monitor is the failure, and no other desktop asks first. Turn it off in System Settings -> Displays, or with `pc-pointer-confine off`. A client that takes a pointer-constraints-v1 grab of its own is left alone, and a single-monitor machine is never affected.
